1. (Currently Amended) An immunogenic composition comprising: a modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus type lb (BVDV-lb) that is distinct from any BVDV Type 1 virus described in WO 2007/117303, __a veterinary-acceptable carrier, and optionally an adjuvant.__

3. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising one or more of a parainfluenza virus Type 3 (PI3), a bovine respiratory syncytial virus (BRSV), a bovine herpes virus (BHV-1), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type la (BVDV-la), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type 2 (BVDV-2), or an infectious bovine rhinotracheitis (IBR) virus, or any combination thereof; or one or more viral-specific antigens obtained therefrom, wherein the composition is free of inactivated bacteria cultures of Leptospira.

4. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising a modified, live IBRV, a modified, live BRSV, a modified, live BHV-1, a modified, live BVDV Type la, a modified, live BVDV Type 2, or a modified, live PI3, or a combination thereof, wherein the composition is free of inactivated bacteria cultures of Leptospira.

6. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising an immunologically effective amount of at least a first antigen that is distinct from any inactivated bacteria cultures of Leptospira.

8. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 6, wherein the at least a first antigen is inactivated and is distinct from any inactivated bacteria cultures of Leptospira.

12. (Currently Amended) The vaccine of claim 4, further comprising an immunologically-effective amount of at least one microbial pathogen-specific antigen that is distinct from any inactivated bacteria cultures of Leptospira.
